result.title: Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing
result.summary: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Omni-RS 遥感统一框架，支持四类理解任务与五类生成任务：先让多模态大模型适配遥感理解，再用其隐状态引导 diffusion transformer 生成，并构建统一多任务生成数据集 UniGen，另用 VAE 编码的视觉条件支持需参考图的生成任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用 MLLM 隐状态作扩散生成条件」的接口，可能与 LVR 关心的 latent 内容是否被下游真正使用、视觉条件是否形成旁路等问题存在可供核查的方法线索；但论文目标为遥感理解与生成的统一，不涉及推理期状态更新或证据获取。
